structure: Part 16 read the three remaining consignment-parties and contact-address feature folders of the live-animals set in repos/trade-imports-animals-frontend (on main), every file in each except the co-located *.test.js unit tests: cph-number/ (page.js, controller.js, template.njk, validate.js, shape.js, evaluation.js, copy/copy.en.js, copy/copy.cy.js, cph-number.fit.spec.js), permanent-address/ (page.js, controller.js, template.njk, validate.js, cards.js, answers.js, write.js, saved-addresses.js, summary.js, copy/copy.en.js, copy/copy.cy.js, permanent-address.fit.spec.js) and contact/ (page.js, controller.js, template.njk, validate.js, evaluation.js, test-support.js, copy/copy.en.js, copy/copy.cy.js, contact.fit.spec.js). It covers three pages. (1) The county parish holding number page, slug cph-number, a sub-page of the consignment addresses hub under the Addresses caption: three numeric boxes laid out as a GOV.UK date input, a collapsible help details, part-by-part validation, a whole-number paste split across the parts, and a skip when no commodity on the consignment needs a CPH. (2) The permanent address page, slug permanent-address, also a sub-page of that hub under the same caption: a fraud warning and one GOV.UK summary card per addressable animal, each card offering the place of destination or a hand-entered address revealed in the card, with the answers written onto the commodity lines' animal records; plus the skip when no line needs one and the no-animals-identified message. (3) The consignment contact page, slug consignment/contact/select, a linear page with no caption: an intro, a hidden-legend radio list of the organisation's branch address-book records hinted with their address, an INS add-address handshake link outside stub mode, and the full three save controls with its own 'hub' wording. For each page the part claims the route and how it is reached, the chrome and copy, every field with label and hint, every option, every validation rule with its message verbatim, the save and back controls, every branch and where it leads, what is written, what each fit spec proves, and Welsh key parity for the three copy.cy.js files. Shared files the three pages reach into (shared/save-actions.njk, shared/copy.en.js, shared/paths.js, lib/validate/validators.js, addresses/party-edit/address-rules.js and its copy, addresses/ins-handshake.js, addresses/parties.js, addresses/party-picker/selection.js, addresses/party-inline.js, commodities/animal-identification/animal-label.js, flow/section-captions and flow/flow.js) were read only as far as these three pages' observable behaviour needs; the consignment addresses hub, check your answers, the task rows and the obligations that consume these answers are other parts' slices and are claimed here only where these three pages' own fit specs render them.
